# tools: add buf as better alternative of grpcurl

Add [buf](https://github.com/bufbuild/buf), the Protobuf build tool, whose `buf curl` ([announcement](https://buf.build/blog/buf-curl)) calls gRPC/Connect endpoints with schema awareness — a richer replacement for `grpcurl`, which the Pro and mini Brewfiles install. Formula: `bufbuild/buf/buf` (tap) or the core `buf`.
